# 2026-03-03

I woke up a bit later than usual this morning. The alarm went off at 7:15 but I hit snooze twice before finally rolling out of bed around 7:45. Made a quick breakfast of toast with avocado and a strong cup of coffee while scrolling through the news. The weather looks decent for the next few days so I might try to get a walk in after work.

## Plan
- Finish drafting the remaining sections of chapter 3
- Respond to all outstanding emails from yesterday
- Schedule dentist appointment before it slips my mind again
- Pick up dry cleaning on the way home
- Review notes from last week's seminar
- Laundry - at least two loads today

The main priority is getting chapter 2 properly reviewed before I move too far ahead. I still need to tighten up a few paragraphs in the methodology section.

## Log
Washed the bedsheets and towels first thing after breakfast. The machine finished around 9:30 so I hung them out on the drying rack since the sun was out. Spent about twenty minutes sorting through the pile of clothes that had accumulated on the chair in the bedroom. Found three socks without matches which is annoying.

Headed to the gym around 11:00. Did a solid leg day - squats, lunges, and some calf raises. The new playlist I made last week worked well and kept me motivated. Stopped by the cafe on the way back and grabbed a smoothie. Ran into my neighbor [[Thomas Reed]] who was also getting his post-workout drink. We chatted briefly about the upcoming building maintenance fees.

Cleared out my inbox after lunch. There were seventeen new messages, mostly newsletters and a couple of work related items. Deleted most of the spam without opening them. Answered the message from [[Sarah Patel]] about the conference submission deadline. Also replied to the group thread about the team offsite planning.

Took a break mid-afternoon to fold the laundry from earlier. The sheets smelled really fresh after being outside. Organized the linen closet while I was at it which felt surprisingly satisfying. Made a quick grocery list for the weekend since we're running low on milk and eggs.

## Meetings
Met with [[Priya Natarajan]] this afternoon at the campus cafe. She looked well and was carrying her usual oversized notebook. We talked for about forty minutes over coffee. She agreed to review chapter 2 and said she could get feedback to me by March 14 at the latest. That gives me enough time to incorporate her suggestions before the next draft deadline. She mentioned she particularly liked the framing in the introduction but wanted to see more examples in the second section. I took detailed notes on her initial thoughts.

The meeting ran a little longer than planned because we got sidetracked discussing the new faculty hiring process. She shared some interesting insights about how the committee is approaching the shortlist this year.

## Reflections
Overall a productive day. The conversation with Priya feels like a weight off my shoulders. Getting external eyes on chapter 2 this early should help avoid major rewrites later. I need to remember to send her the latest version with my tracked changes first thing tomorrow morning.

The gym session left me feeling energized rather than drained which is a nice change. Maybe the new supplements are actually helping. Still need to be better about not letting laundry pile up. The apartment feels calmer when everything is put away.

Been thinking about the feedback loop between writing and exercise. When I maintain both consistently the quality of my work improves noticeably. Need to protect that morning writing block better next week. Also should reach out to [[Marcus Chen]] about the data set he mentioned last month. It might be relevant for chapter 4.

Ended the day with a simple dinner of grilled chicken and vegetables while watching a documentary about urban architecture. Tomorrow looks busy so I should try to get to bed before midnight.
